summary: Alvotech, a Luxembourg-domiciled, Nasdaq-listed biosimilars company, furnished a Form 6-K (its US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) containing a press release announcing financial results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus a business update. No transaction, ownership stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. Financials showed adjusted revenue of $323.4 million versus $420.0 million, a 54% gross margin, adjusted EBITDA of $78.3 million, and cash of $61.5 million. Operational update: FDA accepted the BLA for AVT80. Routine earnings disclosure; no risk-arb angle.
